text:
Maya: FYI handing off Zenora (mid-market analytics platform). Signed last week. High-level: enterprise buyer, needs SSO + EU data residency, 6-8 week onboarding. Renewal in 11 months.

Maya: Current status: contract signed, payment processed, initial infra contact provided (zenora-ops@). Demo + product walkthrough done. Customer ran basic evals -- reported intermittent 5-7s tail latency on long queries.

Jonah: Thanks Maya. I'll take primary CSM. Key success metrics: 95th pct latency < 2s for their 2k token batch, deploy inference to eu-west.

Priya: Tech notes: they are on a custom model variant (xlarge-8q). Kernel mismatch on one node returned slow GC spikes. We saw same pattern in QA last month. Need eng triage for model variant or quantization profile.

Arman: I'll file a support ticket for the latency traces. Maya, can you attach the sample logs + request IDs? Prefer full request/response KV cache dump if possible.

Maya: Adding sample trace + export link to the thread: https://internal-redwood/zenora/traces/zen-2026-03-12-01

Sam: Enablement ops: onboarding kickoff scheduled for 2026-03-25 10:00 CET. Agenda: SSO setup, VPC peering checklist, test load plan, success metrics + escalation path. I'll send calendar invite to zenora-ops + all CS/SE.

Jonah: Renewal risk: low today but medium in 6 months if latency persists or EU compliance not met. Add quarterly QBR and capacity review to cadence.

Priya: Next steps for eng: (1) triage ticket with RTX team (assign to eng-sre), (2) checkpoint quant/profile for xlarge-8q, (3) confirm fallback variant for burst. I'm pinging @eng-sre in the ticket.

Arman: Support ticket created: SUP-4921. Linked to this thread. Triage ETA: 48h.

Maya: Owner list: Jonah (CSM, owner), Priya (SE, tech owner), Arman (Support), Sam (Onboarding ops).

Jonah: I'll own the SSO and compliance pathing; Priya and Arman will take perf triage. Sam will run kickoff and enablement.

Sam: Enablement items: send pre-kickoff checklist to customer by EOD 3/18. Checklist includes test plan, API keys, sample payloads (see snippet):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \ 
  -d '{"model":"xlarge-8q","input":"<sample>"}'
```

Jonah: I'll capture feature ask (streaming partial outputs + structured tool-calls) in product-feedback board and include customer priority.

Maya: Anything else?

Priya: Please flag if they request on-prem deployment; that changes timelines and licensing.

Jonah: Noted. I'll update the playbook and post a short digest after kickoff.

Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:

Arman: Noted, will update SUP-4921 with traces after triage.

Sam: Invite sent. See you on 3/25.

Jonah: Closing handoff — will post weekly status in this thread until onboarding is GA.
thread_text_short: Maya kicks off sales->CS handoff for Zenora: SSO + EU residency, latency issues on xlarge-8q, owners assigned (Jonah/ Priya/ Arman/ Sam), support ticket SUP-4921, kickoff 2026-03-25.
